brief.title: Draft the shift schedule from posted tasks and volunteer availability
brief.plain_summary: Suggest volunteer codes for each posted task by skills, availability and recorded training, and leave a task unmatched with its reason rather than stretch a requirement.
brief.outcome: Draft match suggestions and the unmatched tasks with reasons, for the coordinator.

tasks.description: Pin of a noun holding the posted relief tasks with required skills, training and adults-only marks.

roster.description: Pin of a noun holding registered volunteer codes with skills, recorded training and availability, with no names or contact details.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.match-suggestions's schema.
Every suggested volunteer code has recorded every training its task requires.
No code marked under 18 appears on a task marked adults only.
The output holds no names, phone numbers, email addresses, street addresses or case details.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Match a volunteer code to a task only when every training the task requires appears in that volunteer's recorded training and the shift fits their availability.
Never match a volunteer marked under 18 to a task marked adults only.
Leave a task unmatched rather than stretch a requirement, and give the reason.
Rank only by fit, never by personal traits.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
